en: Sepia-toned photograph of a long historic European building along a cobblestone street. The structure has a steep tiled roof with many small dormer windows, ornate stone portals with statues, and a central tower topped by a dome and cross, bearing large clock faces. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or ride in horse‑drawn carriages along the street. No printed caption or text appears on the front; the image is surrounded by a cream border with scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards.
